# Video/telemetry data dictionary. One row per (Model
# Identity     : Video Device Tag is the CONTAINER tag (encoder/model)
#                NOT the EXIF Model in drones.csv - DJI writes either the human
#                name ('DJI DJI Matrice 4E') or the short code ('DJI M4TD').
#                Comma-separate alternatives. Blank = never seen an intact file;
#                note that any video remuxed through ffmpeg reports 'Lavf...'
#                and cannot be identified at all.
# Camera       : joins drones.csv 'Camera' for sensor geometry. Two ways to tell
#                which camera shot a video: Filename Suffix (the M30T writes one
#                file per camera - _W/_Z/_T) and SRT Focal Len (the 4E writes a
#                single _V file and reports focal_len 24.00 for Wide). The
#                suffix is the stronger signal - it survives remuxing and needs
#                no telemetry - but it cannot identify the MODEL
#                camera within an already-known model.
# Value Scales : per-key divisors
